```{r}

```

Install Times New Roman

```{r}
# Tell R to find Times New Roman
font_add(
  family = "Times New Roman", 
  regular = systemfonts::match_fonts("Times New Roman")$path
)

# Activate showtext
showtext_auto()
```

Create fires table and sf object ordered by proportion treated

```{r}
fires_sub <- st_read("data/processed/fuels_analysis.gpkg", layer = "fires")
my_fires <- read.csv("data/processed/my_fires.csv")

# Note the fires used in regression (fewer than random forest)
transects <- st_read("data/processed/fuels_analysis.gpkg", layer = "transectsDS") 

fires_table <- my_fires %>%
  filter(Incid_Name %in% fires_sub$Incid_Name) %>%
  select(Incid_Name, Fire_Year, Fire_Area_ha, Proportion_Treated) %>%
  arrange(desc(Proportion_Treated)) %>%
  mutate(fire_num = row_number(),
         `Fire Name` = ifelse(!Incid_Name %in% transects$Incid_Name,
                              paste0(Incid_Name, "*"),
                              Incid_Name),
         `Fire Name` = str_to_title(`Fire Name`)) %>%
  as_tibble()

# Join the number onto the sf object using the original name
fires_sub <- fires_sub %>%
  left_join(select(fires_table, Incid_Name, fire_num), by = "Incid_Name")

# Presentation version for the figure
fires_table <- fires_table %>%
  select(`#` = fire_num,
         `Fire Name`,
         Year = Fire_Year,
         `Area (ha)` = Fire_Area_ha,
         `Prop. Treated` = Proportion_Treated)
```


# Make a map of fires across Colorado

```{r}
## Cities
cities <- st_read("D:/Spatial_Data/Cities/Colorado_City_Point_Locations.shp") %>%
  st_transform(crs = crs(fires_sub)) %>%
  filter(name %in% c("Denver"))
## State Boundary 
state <- st_read("D:/Spatial_Data/States/cb_2018_us_state_20m.shp") %>%
  st_transform(crs = crs(fires_sub)) %>%
  filter(NAME == "Colorado")

#Roads
roads <- st_read("D:/Spatial_Data/Highways/Highways%3A_Functional_Class.shp") %>%
  st_transform(crs=crs(fires_sub)) %>%
  filter(FUNCCLASS == "1  Interstate")

elev <- rast("data/processed/Topo/Elevation.tif")

# Reproject state to match the raster's CRS first, then crop
state_elev_crs <- st_transform(state, crs(elev))

elev <- elev %>%
  aggregate(fact = 3, fun = "mean") %>% # reduce resolution before reprojecting
  project(crs(fires_sub))              # reproject last

# Convert to data frame
elev_df <- as.data.frame(elev, xy = TRUE) %>%
  rename(elevation = 3)# Elevation raster

# Make a map!
map <- ggplot() +
  
  # Elevation basemap
  geom_raster(
    data = elev_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y, fill = elevation)
  ) +
  scale_fill_hypso_c(palette = "dem_screen", name = "Elevation (m)") +
  
  # Fires 
  geom_sf(
    data = fires_sub,
    fill = "red",
    color = NA
  ) +
  
   # Fire numbers
  geom_shadowtext(
    data = fires_sub,
    aes(label = fire_num, geometry = geom),
    stat = "sf_coordinates",
    size = 10,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "black",
    bg.color = "white"
  ) +
  #Roads
  geom_sf(
    data = roads,
    fill = NA,
    color = "grey",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  
  # State outline
  geom_sf(
    data = state,
    fill = NA,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    plot.caption = element_text(family = "Times New Roman", size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(family = "Times New Roman", size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman", size = 12),
    legend.position = c(0.75, 0.5),  # x, y as proportion of plot area (adjust as needed)
    legend.justification = c(0, 0),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  ) 

map
ggsave(
  filename = "documents/figures/Map.png",
  plot = map,        
  width = 6,
  height = 5,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300               
)
```

# Add table

```{r}
my_theme <- ttheme_minimal(
  base_size = 12,
  base_family = "Times New Roman",
  core = list(fg_params = list(fontfamily = "Times New Roman", fontsize = 12, hjust = 0.5, x = 0.5)),
  colhead = list(fg_params = list(fontfamily = "Times New Roman", fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold", hjust = 0.5, x = 0.5))
)


table_left  <- fires_table[1:5, ]  %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
table_right <- fires_table[6:10, ] %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.character))

table_left <- table_left %>% mutate(` ` = "")  # spacer column

grob_left  <- tableGrob(table_left,  rows = NULL, theme = my_theme)
grob_right <- tableGrob(table_right, rows = NULL, theme = my_theme)
table_combined <- cbind(grob_left, grob_right)

grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.draw(table_combined)


# Combine map and table
combined <- map / wrap_elements(full = table_combined, clip = FALSE) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1)) &
  theme(plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1),
        panel.spacing = unit(0, "pt"))

ggsave(
  filename = "documents/figures/Map1.png",
  plot = combined,
  width = 8.5,
  height = 9.5,  # taller to accommodate table
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)
```

# Sized for Poster

```{r}
# ---- Poster sizing (edit these) ----
poster_w   <- 11.5       # inches
txt_base   <- 54      # legend / caption text (pt)
txt_table  <- 54       # table text (pt)
fire_label <- 25       # geom_shadowtext size is in mm (14 mm ≈ 40 pt)
font       <- "Times New Roman"

# ---- Map ----
map <- ggplot() +
  geom_raster(data = elev_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = elevation)) +
  scale_fill_hypso_c(palette = "dem_screen", name = "Elevation (m)") +
  geom_sf(data = fires_sub, fill = "red", color = NA) +
  geom_shadowtext(
    data = fires_sub,
    aes(label = fire_num, geometry = geom),
    stat = "sf_coordinates",
    size = fire_label,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "black",
    bg.color = "white",
    bg.r = 0.15
  ) +
  geom_sf(data = roads, fill = NA, color = "grey", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_sf(data = state, fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    plot.caption = element_text(family = font, size = txt_base),
    legend.title = element_text(family = font, size = txt_base),
    legend.text = element_text(family = font, size = txt_base),
    legend.key.height = unit(1.2, "cm"),
    legend.key.width = unit(0.8, "cm"),
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.8, 0.6),
    legend.justification = c(0, 0),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )

# ---- Table ----
my_theme <- ttheme_minimal(
  base_size = txt_table,
  base_family = font,
  core = list(
    fg_params = list(fontfamily = font, fontsize = txt_table, hjust = 0.5, x = 0.5),
    padding = unit(c(4, 1), "mm")
  ),
  colhead = list(
    fg_params = list(fontfamily = font, fontsize = txt_table, fontface = "bold", hjust = 0.5, x = 0.5),
    padding = unit(c(4, 1), "mm")
  )
)

table_left  <- fires_table[1:5, ]  %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
table_right <- fires_table[6:10, ] %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
table_left  <- table_left %>% mutate(` ` = "")

grob_left  <- tableGrob(table_left,  rows = NULL, theme = my_theme)
grob_right <- tableGrob(table_right, rows = NULL, theme = my_theme)
grob_left$widths[ncol(grob_left)] <- unit(1.5, "cm")   # spacer column width
table_combined <- cbind(grob_left, grob_right)

# Check that it actually fits in 12"
# Measure on the saving device (ragg) so font metrics match
ragg::agg_png(tempfile(), width = fig_w, height = 5, units = "in", res = 300)
table_w <- grid::convertWidth(sum(table_combined$widths), "in", valueOnly = TRUE)
table_h <- grid::convertHeight(sum(table_combined$heights), "in", valueOnly = TRUE)
invisible(dev.off())
c(width = table_w, height = table_h)

# ---- Layout ----
side_pad <- 0.1    # inches of white space on each side (this is the "a bit wider")
fig_w    <- poster_w + 2 * side_pad

# Exact height of the map panel at poster_w wide
b     <- ggplot_build(map)
asp   <- b$layout$coord$aspect(b$layout$panel_params[[1]])   # height / width
map_h <- poster_w * asp

# ---- Save map alone ----
map_final <- map + theme(plot.margin = margin(0, side_pad, 0, side_pad, "in"))
ggsave("documents/figures/PosterMap.png", map_final,
       width = fig_w, height = map_h, units = "in", dpi = 300)

# ---- Combine ----
combined <- map / plot_spacer() / wrap_elements(full = table_combined, clip = FALSE) +
  plot_layout(heights = unit(c(map_h, gap, table_h), "in")) &
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0, side_pad, 0, side_pad, "in"),
        panel.spacing = unit(0, "pt"))

ggsave("documents/figures/PosterMap1.png", combined,
       width = fig_w, height = map_h + table_h, units = "in", dpi = 300, device = ragg::agg_png)
```
